_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate of ±2+ point moves across 72 windows makes HOLD the skilled, statistically grounded call — no breaker is present to justify a directional claim.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD signal, but analyst forward-calls Disbelief (+1) while narrative stays in Denial; the split is on phase progression timing, not direction
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX sustains below 12 with DXY breaking under 98.5 and btc_momentum_30d pushing above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 18 with DXY reclaiming 101 and funding flipping negative
